invariants.name: invariant_solvencyWeak
invariants.description: balance + un-pulled mintDebt >= rewardBudget + committedDebt at all times across stake/unstake/claim/depositFor/emergencyWithdraw/migration sequences.

invariants.name: invariant_solvencyStrongNoMintDebt
invariants.description: When mintDebt == 0, balance >= rewardBudget + committedDebt (the NatSpec equality holds within floor dust, protocol-favourable; only a deficit is a defect).

invariants.name: invariant_conservation
invariants.description: Held balance always covers committedDebt; absent an owner rescue (obvious Law-3 action) no single actor's pending exceeds the entire held balance.

invariants.name: invariant_depositForPaysStakerNotMigrator
invariants.description: story-026 / audit-21 M-03 fix: depositFor's pre-credit settlement pays the STAKER, never the MIGRATOR. Sentinel latches if the migrator ever receives reward via depositFor.

invariants.name: invariant_finalizeReachable
invariants.description: From Migrating with a fully drained pool, finalizeAndReset always succeeds (the only route back to Active and to re-enabling stake/depositFor).

invariants.name: invariant_frozenSnapshot
invariants.description: While Migrating, accRewardPerShare never moves; every user's pending is pinned at the initiateMigration snapshot (no retro-accrual).

invariants.name: invariant_captureSelfDisabled
invariants.description: InPlace migrator's _depositForAndForward captures 0 against V2 (V2 pays user direct) => totalUnforwarded == 0. Mirror of the V1 forwarding proof, showing the leg is correctly INERT.

invariants.name: invariant_noUnforwardedCredit
invariants.description: No parked user ever accrues an unforwarded escrow credit against V2 (captured==0).

invariants.name: invariant_migratorHoldsNoSettlement
invariants.description: The migrator never retains protocol settlement (totalUnforwarded==0); any balance is pure third-party donation, owner-rescuable, never trapped user reward.

antiVacuity.seedAssertions: Both setUp()s hard-assert a funded budget, live emission rate, real accrual, real payment, non-empty pool, and (forwarding harness) a live forward branch with owed>0 and users paid direct while migrator captured 0 — suite aborts before any invariant runs if guarded state is empty.
antiVacuity.census: Deterministic test_coverageCensus in each file reports per-op call counts and hard-asserts value moved and every branch (stake-gate revert, depositFor-with-pending, migration exits, finalize, live forward branch) was genuinely reached.
